# Fazeshift

Fazeshift is a Software Development company. Fazeshift is an AI-powered platform that offers an AI-powered platform to automate accounts receivable, invoicing, payment matching, and customer communications. Fazeshift employs 44 people (+388.9% YoY, +35 people). Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

## About

Fazeshift is an AI-driven accounts receivable platform designed to help enterprises automate invoicing, cash application, and collections—improving efficiency, reducing errors, and accelerating revenue cycles. 

Big enterprises trust Fazeshift to:
- Automate invoice creation and distribution, eliminating manual processing.
- Enhance collections with AI-powered reminders and predictive payment insights.
- Seamlessly integrate with ERP and accounting systems to ensure accurate reconciliation.

Without automation, businesses struggle with slow payments, revenue leakage, and inefficient AR management. Fazeshift transforms AR from a bottleneck into a growth driver.

Supercharge your cash flow with intelligent automation. Visit www.fazeshift.com.

properties.description:
Fazesoft is a technology-driven software development company founded in 2024, dedicated to delivering innovative, scalable, and high-quality digital solutions for businesses and organizations worldwide.

Since our inception, we have successfully completed 10+ major projects across multiple industries and continue to work on numerous ongoing projects. Our expertise spans a wide range of technologies and services, enabling us to transform ideas into powerful digital products.

Our Services
Custom Software Development
Web Application Development
Mobile Application Development
AI Chatbots & Intelligent Automation
Headless CMS Solutions
UI/UX Design
E-Commerce Solutions
API Development & Integration
Cloud-Based Applications
Digital Transformation Services
What We Build

At Fazesoft, we develop modern digital experiences ranging from business websites and enterprise software to AI-powered applications and scalable SaaS platforms. Our team combines technical excellence, creative design, and strategic thinking to deliver solutions that drive growth and efficiency.

Our Mission

To empower businesses with innovative technology solutions that solve real-world problems, enhance productivity, and create lasting value.

Our Vision

To become a globally recognized technology company known for excellence in software engineering, innovation, and client success.

Founded: 2024
Projects Delivered: 10+ Major Projects
Core Focus: Software Development, Web Applications, Mobile Apps, AI Solutions, Headless CMS, and Digital Innovation

Fazesoft — Building & Innovating Scalable Digital Solutions for the Future.
